no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee meeting held to discuss this NDA. This is the third drug approved in this class. There were no significant public health questions that required the input of the committee or outside expertise.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the VARUBI (rolapitant) NDA206500 review. The Summary Review (L233), the Office/Division Director memo (ODMemo L130), and the Medical Review (MedR L914, 'N/A') all state that the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it raised no significant public health questions and outside expertise was not necessary (rolapitant was the third NK1 receptor antagonist approved in its class for prevention of CINV). With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
